title: Ag-Pd alloy decorated ZnIn2S4 microspheres with optimal Schottky barrier height for boosting visible-light-driven hydrogen evolution

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: Visible-light photocatalytic H2 evolution on ZnIn2S4 needs faster separation of photogenerated carriers and more active surface sites. Tuning the Ag:Pd ratio of an alloy cocatalyst sets an appropriate Schottky barrier height on ZIS and so maximises H2 evolution.
states.detail: Absorbed: h1 (HYP/need), h2 (HYP/hypothesis), d1 (DES/base_system), d2 (DES/modification), d3 (DES/variable_sweep), p1 (PRC/synthesis), p2 (PRC/synthesis)

states.title: Structure state
states.head: Nanometre-sized Ag-Pd particles are dispersed over the ZIS nanosheet surface. Ag and Pd form an interacting alloy: electron density redistributes between Ag and Pd in Ag0.25Pd0.75-ZIS.
states.detail: Absorbed: s2 (STR/microstructure/distribution), s4 (STR/chemistry/bonding), s5 (STR/interface). Premises: Work functions: Ag 4.7 eV, Pd 5.1 eV

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: Photoelectrons in the ZIS conduction band (-0.87 eV) cross the Schottky barrier into the Ag-Pd particles while holes are consumed by S2-/SO3 2-, separating carriers. Ag0.25Pd0.75-ZIS shows the most efficient photocarrier separation, ranking Ag0.25Pd0.75-ZIS > Pd-ZIS > Ag-ZIS > ZIS.
states.detail: Absorbed: m1 (MEC/pathway), pr2 (PRP/value), pr3 (PRP/value), m2 (MEC/pathway). Premises: Ag-Pd Fermi level lies below the ZIS conduction band, so CB electrons flow into the metal; Higher photocurrent, smaller EIS arc and lower PL intensity indicate faster carrier separation / less recombination; Sabatier principle: the best HER catalyst has H* adsorption free energy near zero

states.title: Performance state
states.head: Ag0.25Pd0.75-ZIS gives the highest H2 evolution rate, 125.4 umol/h, 83.6x ZIS and 3.6x Pd-ZIS

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: Ag0.25Pd0.75 alloy on ZIS boosts visible-light H2 evolution through a bimetallic synergy of optimal Schottky barrier (carrier separation), light harvesting and near-zero H* binding
